query:
UPDATE provider_playback_sessions
               SET credential_owner_id = $2,
                   resource_version = $3,
                   session = $4,
                   state = 1,
                   lease_expires_at = $5,
                   stop_position = NULL,
                   stop_reason = NULL,
                   cleanup_attempts = 0,
                   next_cleanup_at = NULL,
                   cleanup_lease_until = NULL,
                   cleanup_fence = cleanup_fence
                       + CASE WHEN state IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               WHERE id = $1
